title: malaxis obcordata
intro: Malaxis obcordata, commonly known as the Heart-shaped Malaxis or Heart-leaved Malaxis, is a type of orchid native to tropical regions of Asia. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and improving immune function. The therapeutic actions of Malaxis obcordata include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Malaxis obcordata have been found to possess antioxidant and free radical scavenging activities, contributing to its potential therapeutic effects.
